title: Observability handoff protocol for Dedicated VPC and on-prem collectors
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define and implement a robust, observable handoff protocol between perimeter collectors (VPC/on-prem) and Redwood central ingest for Dedicated and Private deployments. Goal: provide end-to-end delivery guarantees for traces, metrics, and logs while preserving tenant isolation and low-latency fast-paths for traces. This ticket covers protocol definition, collector handshake, ack/replay semantics, signature rotation, operational dashboards for handoff health, and a compatibility shim for legacy sidecars.
background: Customers running Dedicated and Private deployments have reported intermittent telemetry gaps during collector restarts and network churn. Current fans of collectors use simple TCP/HTTP forwarding with ad-hoc retry; we need an explicit handoff protocol that makes delivery observable, supports replay without duplication, and enforces tenant boundaries for multi-tenant VPCs.
goals: Formalize an idempotent handoff/ack protocol for traces, metrics, logs
Add a short-latency fast-path for trace spans (sub-50ms added) and a batched high-throughput path for logs/metrics
Expose per-tenant handoff metrics and a dashboard for lag, failed handoffs, and replay rates
Provide secure auth (mutual TLS + rotating HMAC signatures) and audit logs for handoffs
Ship a backward-compatible collector shim for older on-prem sidecars
acceptance_criteria: Protocol spec reviewed and approved by Security and Infra (link to design)
Collector implements handshake, ack, and replay token semantics with end-to-end deduplication
Console dashboard shows per-tenant handoff lag (95th/99th), recent replays, and error breakdowns
E2E test demonstrating zero-loss across simulated collector restart with 99.99% success rate in lab
Rollout plan with canary and automatic fallback to current forwarding path
tasks: Add client-side handshake and persistent queue to on-prem collector
Implement HMAC signature rotation and mTLS bootstrapping flow
Emit new telemetry: handoff_attempts, handoff_success, handoff_replay_count, handoff_lag_ms
Create Console dashboard and alerts for >5% replay rate or lag >5s
Write integration tests and chaos test harness for network partitions
risks_and_open_questions: Replay semantics vs duplication: how to guarantee dedupe across long windows without unbounded tokens
Latency impact: additional handshake may add RTT; need to measure fast-path optimizations
Key rotation UX for customers with air-gapped private deployments and HSM-backed keys
Backwards compatibility with collectors running older runtime versions
deploy_plan: Canary deploy on Dedicated tenants first (10% of traffic) with feature flag 'handoff_v2'. Monitor handoff_success and handoff_lag for 48 hours then increase to 50% then 100%. Provide kill-switch to revert to legacy forwarding. For Private air-gapped customers, deliver collector-sidecar patch and a migration guide for manual key exchange.
monitoring_and_alerting: Add Prometheus metrics with tenant label. Console shows handoff_lag histogram, replay rate, and per-tenant error rates. Alerting: P1 when >1% tenants exceed 10s lag or >3% replay rate in 1h window.
privacy_compliance: Ensure tenant identifiers are hashed before leaving customer VPC unless customer opts-in. Audit logs must redact PII. Security review required and scheduled.
notes: Prototype implemented in ingest-gateway branch 'handoff-proto' — initial results show trace fast-path adds ~12ms median. Code needs optimization for large batched log paths. Next steps: security review and key-rotation flow for HSM customers.
